# SMS Marketing Skill

Plans, builds and optimizes SMS/MMS marketing programs for DTC brands, mobile apps and SaaS: welcome flows, abandoned-cart sequences (the highest-ROI ecom flow), browse abandonment, post-purchase, win-back and flash-sale campaigns, plus transactional/auth texts. Covers where SMS beats email and where it doesn't, full copy guidelines (160-character segments, one CTA, one short link, sender identity on every send), sequence templates with exact timing, platform picks by use case (Klaviyo, Postscript, Attentive, Twilio, Brevo, SimpleTexting, Customer.io), measurement benchmarks (CTR, revenue per send, opt-out guardrails) — all on a compliance-first foundation: US TCPA express written consent, STOP/HELP handling, quiet hours, mandatory A2P 10DLC registration since 2022, plus EU GDPR-derived consent and Canadian CASL notes. Discovered via skills.sh. Honest note: every send costs real money (~$0.0075–$0.04 plus carrier fees), so a small high-quality list beats a large tired one; US messages get filtered without A2P 10DLC registration and TCPA penalties are severe — compliance is not optional; you'll need your own SMS platform account on top of this skill. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
